/* cppi::002a50cddf3496e734dc89fc1219c3304c59594fbb49a2739b09123501307c68 */
WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-02'
),
main_holdings AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN cppib_sec_id
            ELSE abor_security_number
        END AS id_instrument
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-02'
)

SELECT
    'asset_equity' AS table_name,
    h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
    NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
    h.id_instrument,
    sec.abor_instrument_type_id AS instrument_id_type,

    -- h.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
    sec.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
    h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
    h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
    h.balance_nominal_number AS quantity,
    h.clean_price AS current_price,
    h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS market_value,
    h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
    h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
    h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
    me.cusip,
    me.isin,
    me.bloomberg_exchange,
    me.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    me.bloomberg_unique_id,
    me.listing_country_code,
    me.sedol,
    me.ticker,
    me.currency_code,
    me.trade_currency_code,
    me.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
    me.sub_type,
    mp.cppib_party_id,
    mp.party_name,
    mp.domicile_country_code,
    ms.cppib_sec_id,
    ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
    mco.country_code,
    mco.country_name,
    ms.cppib_currency_code,
    ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,
    mcu.currency_code AS mcu_currency_code,
    mcu.currency_name,
    smp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
    me_underlying.sedol AS underlying_sedol,
    '2025-06-02' AS business_date,
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_2,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
    r.rating_Value AS party_rating_value,
    s.rating_Value AS security_rating_value
FROM RankedSecurities sec
LEFT JOIN main_holdings h
    ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
JOIN asset.asset_equity me
    ON CAST(me.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) = h.id_instrument
    AND me.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms 
    ON h.id_instrument = CAST(ms.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
    AND ms.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes mco
    ON ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = mco.country_code 
    AND mco.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes mcu
    ON ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = mcu.currency_code 
    AND mcu.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN party.party mp
    ON me.cppib_party_id = mp.cppib_party_id 
    AND mp.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.model_portfolios smp 
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = smp.id_model_portfolio 
    AND smp.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity me_underlying                                                      
    ON CAST(me_underlying.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(me.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
    AND me_underlying.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_dev.cppib_party_rating r
    ON r.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
    AND r.cppib_party_id = CAST(me.cppib_party_id AS INT)
    AND r.business_date = '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN party.party_enterprise_classification e
    ON e.cppib_party_id = CAST(me.cppib_party_id AS INT)
    AND e.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_dev.cppib_security_rating s
    ON s.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
    AND s.cppib_sec_id = CAST(h.id_instrument AS INT)
    AND s.business_date = '2025-06-02'
WHERE sec.rn = 1
AND h.business_date = '2025-06-02'
AND h.abor_security_type_name = 'Public Fund'

with date_adjusted as (
    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,
        case
            when False and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-04-02') and date '2025-04-03'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-04-03'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-04-02' and date '2025-04-03'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time
where arrival_time = max_publish

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	from risk_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi
		join risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd f on f.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
		and dpi.business_date = f.business_date
		join risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-05-23'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (
			dpi.maturity_date is null
			or to_date(dpi.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= dpi.maturity_date
		)
		 AND  h.investment_strat in ('Europe')
		 and not (  dpi.security_group_name in ('Call Money Funding Services', 'Cash Bucket', 'Cost', 'Internal Funding Source and Loans', 'FX Non Deliverable Forward', 'Pooled Fund Private Equity', 'Private Debt Direct', 'Private Equity Direct'))
),
hedge_ratio_short_long as (
	select sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'LONG' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as long_hedge_pv,
		sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'SHORT' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as short_hedge_pv,
		sum(fcp_base) fcp_base_pv,
		'Y' subtruct_fcp

with asset_instrument_classifications as
(
    select
    abor_security_number as id_holding_decomposition,
    'SECURITY_NO' as holding_decomposition_id_type_code,
    security_type_id as "Security type",
    security_type_name as "Security type name",
    cppib_party_name as "Issuer Name",
    cppib_party_id as id_issuer_party,
--    issuer_ratings as "credit_rating",
    business_date
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite
    where business_date = date'2025-06-02'
    and sec_status = 'ACTV'  -- to only include active securities
    and esm_sec_type != 'Investran security'  -- to filter out Investran LP securities
),
repo_holdings_details as
(
    select
    hold.abor_security_number as "id_instrument",
    undl.cppib_sec_id as "id_underlying_instrument",
    undl.abor_security_type_id as "Underlying Security Type",
    hold.business_date
    from reference.scd_securities sec

    left join reference.scd_securities undl on undl.scd_security_key_id = sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id and undl.business_date = sec.business_date
    where hold.business_date = '2025-06-02'
    and hold.abor_security_type_id in ('REPO', 'REVREPO', 'BUYSELBACK', 'SELBUYBACK')
    and hold.exposure_portfolio_currency != 0
),
asset_bonds as 
(
    select 
    cast(cppib_sec_id as varchar) as cppib_sec_id,
    cppib_party_id,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-06-02'
),
party as
(
    select 
    cppib_party_id,
    party_name as "Underlying Issuer Name",
    business_date
    from party.party
    where business_date = date'2025-06-02'
),
party_ratings as
(
    select 
    cppib_party_id,
    rating_agency,

/* cppi::93e9d07328c50cfcb8ea670c92a722d40578b6494cd83192c5d29cbf5b2816e3 */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( with RankedTransactions as (
	select
		*,
		row_number() over ( partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by extract_time desc ) as row_rank
	from
		trades_deals.scd_transactions
), MaxBusinessDates as (
	select
		( select MAX(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio ) as max_mp_bd,
		( select MAX(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ) as max_ist_bd,
		( select MAX(business_date)	from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite ) as max_secc_bd,
		( select MAX(business_date)	from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite ) as max_pcc_bd
)
select
	mp.model_portfolio_name,
	upcc.epm_party_name,
	pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel2,
	tr.trade_date,
	tr.model_portfolio_id,
	tr.abor_transaction_number,
	tr.abor_security_id,
	secc.esm_security_name,
	tr.payment_date,
	tr.settlement_date,
	tr.period_closure_agreement_date,
	tr.changed_date,
	tr.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	tr.quotation_currency,
	tr.price,
	tr.business_transaction_code_name,
	tr.elementary_transaction_code_name
from
	RankedTransactions tr
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp 
    on
	tr.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
	and mp.business_date = ( select max_mp_bd from MaxBusinessDates )
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist 
    on
	tr.model_portfolio_id = ist.model_portfolio
	and ist.business_date = ( select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates )
	and ist.investmentstructure in ('CPPIB_F24')
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    on
	tr.abor_security_id = secc.abor_security_id
	and secc.business_date = ( select max_secc_bd from MaxBusinessDates )
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
	secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = ( select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates )
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite upcc
	on
	pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = upcc.enterprise_party_id
	and upcc.business_date = ( select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates )
where
	tr.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
	and tr.row_rank = 1
	and tr.scd_portfolio_group in ('ACPP', 'BCPP', 'CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY')
	and tr.trade_date > '2025-03-31'
limit 100 ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 10:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::fa7d6c81a5254ef8525317ba7842f35bd9a2fecaf0d4e1fd1479349e594feace */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-29')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-29')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code

/* cppi::1d3ab49afa4501df2f4373e549c2e9ab8bd1c36a399b618c383945e73baeb3ed */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-27')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-27')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT

    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data

                    from performance.production_sa_index_local_excess_return 
                    where business_date between date '1989-07-31' and date '2025-02-01'
                    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-03-03'

from performance.production_sa_index_local_excess_return r
join max_ver m on r.business_date = m.business_date and r.arrival_time = m.arrival_time and r.index_id = m.index_id

/* cppi::7cc87f8bf2d118b68371886cae1089360cce61adcfa52a17fd99966103249af5 */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten) AS max_ist_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl) AS max_psl_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite) AS max_secc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_pcc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)
SELECT
    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel2,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel3,
    psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_2 as quoted_currency,
    psl.aggregation_level_3 as scd_security_id,
    secc.esm_security_name,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency,
    psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency, 
    psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency, 
    psl.market_value_reporting_currency, 
    psl.market_value_quotation_currency,
    coalesce (pcc.epm_party_name, epc.epm_party_name) as issuer,
    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent
FROM 
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
    ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
    AND ist.business_date = (select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
    AND ist.investmentstructure IN ('CPPIB_F24')
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities scds
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = scds.abor_security_id
    AND scds.business_date = (select max_scds_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
	on scds.abor_issuer_id = spi.party_id
	and spi.business_date = (select max_spi_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite epc
	on epc.party_id = spi.party_id 
	and epc.business_date = (select max_epc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
LEFT JOIN cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = secc.abor_security_id
    AND secc.business_date = (select max_secc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
	and pcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite upcc
	on coalesce (pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id, epc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id) = upcc.enterprise_party_id
	and upcc.business_date = (select max_pcc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
WHERE 
    psl.business_date = '2025-04-29' ) ds LIMIT 0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Acronyms:
-- - ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
-- - CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
-- - CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
-- - NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
-- - HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Data Lineage Summary:
-- - Holdings Source:       holdings_uat.ci_sentry_holdings
--                          (CI Sentry - current holdings data)
-- - Security Metadata:     reference.ci_sentry_security
--                          (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
-- - Coupon Metadata:       reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--                          (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
-- - business_date     : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_holdings.
-- - asset_type filter : Hardcoded list of included asset types.
-- - seniority filter  : Hardcoded list of included seniorities.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata, includes
--   filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.0 | 2025-04-28 | kbaxter@cppib.com
-- - Corrected filtering - moved the schedules to a CTE. The join and where conditions
--   were causing incorrect result set.
-- - Added the injections for the full table names to allow different environments
-- - Removed reference to ci_sentry_commtiments - funded_amount will come from ci_sentry_holdings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

included_asset_types AS (

                        cast(mh.business_date as varchar) as business_date, --key
                        mh.model_portfolio_id, --key
                        mh.scd_holding_key_id, --key
                        mh.abor_security_number, --key
                        mh.cppib_sec_id, --key

                        mh.abor_security_id,

                        ist.model_portfolio_name,
                        mh.quotation_currency_code as "currency",

                        ist.level_2_nodename as "department",
                        ist.level_3_nodename as "signal",
                        ist.level_4_nodename as "invgroup",
                        
                        mh.abor_security_name,
                        mh.abor_instrument_type,
                        mh.abor_security_type_name,
                        mh.abor_country_of_security,
                        mh.abor_country_of_exposure_name,
                       
                        mh.abor_maturity_date,
                        s.abor_coupon_rate,
                        s.isin_id,
                        s.cusip_id,
                        s.bb_global_id,
                        
                        CASE
                            WHEN s.abor_quote_type IS NULL THEN 'Per unit'
                            ELSE s.abor_quote_type
                        END as "abor_quote_type",

                        CASE
                            WHEN s.abor_quote_factor IS NULL THEN 1
                            ELSE s.abor_quote_factor
                        END as "abor_quote_factor",

                        mh.balance_nominal_number,

                        mh.clean_price,
                        mh.dirty_price,

                        --PC == reporting_currency == CAD
                        --QC == quotation_currency == Local

                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_quotation_currency
                            ELSE mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency
                        END as "balance_cost_local",
                        mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as "clean_value_local",
                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN 0
                            ELSE mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency
                        END as "total_accrual_local",
                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_quotation_currency
                            ELSE mh.clean_value_quotation_currency + mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency
                        END as "total_mtm_local",

                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency
                            ELSE mh.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency
                        END as "balance_cost_cad",
                        mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency as "clean_value_cad",

                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN 0
                            ELSE mh.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + mh.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + mh.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + mh.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency
                        END as "total_accrual_cad",
                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency
                            ELSE mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency + mh.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + mh.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + mh.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + mh.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency
                        END as "total_mtm_cad",
                       
                        mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate,
                        
                        s.reporting_id_name,
                        party.cppib_party_id,
                        p.party_name as issuer_name,
                        p.ticker as issuer_ticker,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as issuer_gics_sector,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as issuer_gics_industry_group,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as issuer_gics_industry,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as issuer_gics_subindustry

                    from holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
                    left join asset.asset_security_party_relationship party on CAST(party.cppib_sec_id as int) = CAST(mh.cppib_sec_id as int) and party.business_date = Date('2025-06-02') and role = 'ISSUER'
                    left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_number = mh.abor_security_number and s.business_date = '2025-06-02'
                    left join finance_accounting.v_investment_structure ist on mh.model_portfolio_id = ist.id_model_portfolio and ist.business_date = date('2025-06-02') 
                    left join party.party p on cast(p.cppib_party_id as int) = cast(party.cppib_party_id as int) and p.business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
                    left join party.party_enterprise_classification class on cast(p.cppib_party_id as int) = cast(class.cppib_party_id as int) and class.business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
                    where mh.business_date = '2025-06-02' and ist.level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments'

                ), security_ratings as (
                    select
                        cppib_sec_id, 
                        type, 
                        sub_type, 
                        rating_agency, 
                        rating_date, 
                        cppib_party_id, 
                        rating_value, 
                        adj_lgd, 
                        business_date, 
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY cppib_sec_id, rating_agency
                            ORDER BY business_date DESC
                        ) AS rn
                    FROM performance.cppib_security_rating_pit
                    WHERE active = 'Y'               
                ), issuer_ratings as (
                    select
                        cppib_party_id, 
                        type, 
                        rating_type, 
                        rating_agency, 
                        rating_value, 
                        business_date, 
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY cppib_party_id, rating_agency
                        ) AS rn
                    FROM performance.cppib_party_rating_pit 
                    WHERE active='Y'
                )

                select 
                    h.*,
                    sr.rating_date as security_rating_date, 
                    sr.rating_value as security_rating_value,
                    ir.rating_value as issuer_rating_value

                FROM holdings h
                left join security_ratings sr on CAST(h.cppib_sec_id as int) = CAST(sr.cppib_sec_id as int) and sr.rn = 1 and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
                left join issuer_ratings ir on h.cppib_party_id = ir.cppib_party_id and ir.rn = 1 and ir.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'

                order by invgroup

/* cppi::811cd17e183e3546eb2a73726db6a7197e51e0f5c918ca4582c4c15b06a957dc */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 16:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	es.isin,

	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	st.model_portfolio_id,
	st.business_transaction_code,
	st.settlement_currency,
	cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,

	st.nominal,
	st.nominal_basis,
	st.elementary_transaction_code,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
	st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
	st.reconciliation_status,
	st.created_date,
	ep.party_id,
	ep.epm_party_name,
	st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
	st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	st.external_short_tag,
	st.settlement_date,
	st.quotation_currency,
	st.number_of_units,
	case 
		when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') and st.abor_security_name like '%CAD%' then 'Y'
		when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') then 'N'
	end cross_deal_indicator,
	st.settlement_location,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_exchange_country.country_name as esm_country_name,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name as esm_incorp_country_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	ss.abor_security_group_name,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name as country_ref_name,
	rcc.currency_name as quotation_currency_name,
	st.price as price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
	shm.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from party.enterprise_party
) ep
	on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
	and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over (partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,

	from party.enterprise_party

left join reference.scd_securities ss

left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec

    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,

		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
	group by abor_transaction_number, business_date, transaction_cancellation_flag, trade_date
) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id, portfolio_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from holdings.scd_holdings_main

	on shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
	and shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
	and shm.rn = 1
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
	on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	and rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes)
where st.rn = 1 ) ds LIMIT 0

 , c.instrument_type instrumenttype

 , concat(c.id_reference_name,' ', replace(cast(cast(c.strike_price * 100 as decimal(10,1)) as varchar),'.0',''), ' ', c.option_type, ' ', substring(cast(c.option_expiry_date as varchar),6,2),'/',substring(cast(c.option_expiry_date as varchar),9,2),'/',substring(cast(c.option_expiry_date as varchar),1,4), ' Option | TradeId:', c.trade_id) sec_name
 , c.original_notional_currency ccy
 , 'FIXED' cpn_type
 , c.strike_price  cpn_rate
 , c.underlying_maturity_date maturity
 , v.abor_country_of_security country 
 , ttt.translation region
 , g.name sector 
 , tt.translation rating 
 , 'SNR UNSEC' rank
 , 'LIQUID' liquidity
 , (c.underlying_current_quantity) * (case when c.option_type='Put' then -1 else 1 end) face_local 
 , v.clean_value_quotation_currency fair_value_local
 , v.clean_value_portfolio_currency fair_value_cad
 , null total_exposure 
      , /*DAY2*/ null ytm
    , /*DAY2*/ null ytw
    , /*DAY2*/ null stw
    , /*DAY2*/ null rates_duration
    , /*DAY2*/ null ir01
    , /*DAY2*/ null ir01_cad
    , /*DAY2*/ null credit_duration
    , /*DAY2*/ null cs01
    , /*DAY2*/ null cs01_cad
 , null gl_price
 , null alf_sector
 , c.trade_strategy_name model_portfolio
 , /*DAY2*/ null  ci_sector
 , v.abor_security_number scd_id
 , null libor_floor
 , v.cppib_sec_id cpp_secid 
 , v.yield all_in_cpn 
 , c.document_type industry_group
 , a.isin isin 
 , c.system analytics_source
 , /*OUT*/ null carry
 , (c.underlying_current_quantity) * (case when c.option_type='Put' then -1 else 1 end)  * c.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad face_cad
 , concat(a.isin, ' ', a.market_sector_desc) bloombergcode
 , rrr.rating_value rawRating
 , t.translation warf
 , tttt.translation region_alt1 
 , concat(tttt.translation,'|',tt.translation) credit_char
 , null as murex_strategy_code
 , c.trade_id trade_id
 , c.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad fx_rate
 , 'SCD' source_system 
 , v.scd_security_id source_system_id
 , now() extract_date
from holdings.scd_holdings_main v
 left join trades_deals.otc_credit_index_option_trades c
  on date(v.business_date) = c.business_date 
   and v.abor_security_number = c.id_instrument
   and c.instrument_id_type = 'CONTRACT_ID'
   and c.run_description in ('EOD','EOM')
 left join reference.scd_model_portfolio m
  on v.model_portfolio_id = m.model_portfolio_id
   and v.business_date = (m.business_date)
 left join party.party pp
  on c.id_counterparty = cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar)
   and date(v.business_date) = (pp.business_date)
 left join party.party_gics_classifications g
  on date(v.business_date)=g.business_date 
   and c.id_counterparty=cast(g.cppib_party_id as varchar)
   and g.level_type='SECTOR'
 left join party.party_ratings rrr
  on date(v.business_date)=rrr.business_date 
   and cast(c.id_counterparty as int) = rrr.cppib_party_id 
   and rrr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers a
  on date(v.business_date)=a.business_date 
   and c.id_reference_index=cast(a.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
   and c.reference_index_id_type='CPPIBSEC_ID'
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_WARF_Mapping') t
	     ON upper(rrr.rating_value)=upper(t.phrase)   
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_Raw_Rating_Mapping') tt
         ON upper(rrr.rating_value)=upper(tt.phrase)   
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_CO_CI_Region_Def_Mapping') ttt
         ON upper(v.abor_country_of_security)=upper(ttt.phrase)
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_CO_Region_Alt1_Mapping') tttt
         ON upper(v.abor_country_of_security)=upper(tttt.phrase)

where v.business_date >= date_format(date_add('day', -7, date('2025-06-03')), '%Y-%m-%d')
 and v.business_date <= date_format(date('2025-06-03'), '%Y-%m-%d')
 and v.model_portfolio_id in (select 'CIPCEMS' as id_model_portfolio union select 'CIPCDMS' as id_model_portfolio union select 'CICOCS' as id_model_portfolio union select 'CIPCSFO' as id_model_portfolio union select 'CIIGPLUS' as id_model_portfolio)
 and v.abor_security_type_id in ('OP_OC_CR')

	select

		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name

		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0

			, sum(
				case

			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region

)

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date
    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I667D'
),
latest_file_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I667D'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,
    comp.component_ref_entity_name,
    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,
    comp.component_ref_entity_type,
    comp.component_ref_entity_weight AS component_weight,
    comp.component_coupon_type,
    comp.component_currency,
    comp.component_maturity,
    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,
    evt.auction_date,
    evt.tier_name,
    evt.auction_price,
    evt.auction_cash_settlement_date AS settlement_date

    ON idx.index_clip = comp.index_clip

    AND idx.file_date = (SELECT max_file_date FROM latest_file_date)
    AND SUBSTRING(comp.index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I667D'
    AND evt.auction_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    idx.index_series ASC, idx.index_version ASC, comp.component_ref_entity_ticker ASC

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

		left join (

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 06:11:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *
FROM (
  with ae_temp as (
      select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
             (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   else abacus_pv_base_ccy end
             ) as exposure
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_position"
      where investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and portfolio_type = 'IP' and product_type in ('Common Stock','Common Stock Private','Convertible_bond','Equity Swap','Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index','Unit','Pooled Fund Absolute Return','Listed Warrant','Preferred Stock','REIT','Depository Receipt','Leveraged Loans') and long_short = 'LONG'
  ),
  
  analytics as (
      select business_date, node, analytic_name, analytic_value
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_analytics"
      where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
      and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
      and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
      and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
  )
  
  select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
         (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
  from (
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
  
      union
  
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
  ) as q1
  right join analytics 
  on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
) "custom_sql_query"
LIMIT 0) T LIMIT 0

SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' 
and business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
UNION
SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
    ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
    format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
Left Join ( 
    SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
    FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
WHERE MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
and MainTable.business_date>=DATE '2000-01-01'
order by business_date, from_currency

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-25')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-25')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-25')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

        Left Join

                case

                end as mid_price,

                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 12:06:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-30')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-30')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('MPINLCP1D')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,

    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-30')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 11:01:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code

	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code

	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades

 )

select a.*, b.*, d.*, e.*,pr.*, f.country_name, g.currency_name, h.* ,r.rating_Value
   from (select h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
        cast(h.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR) AS id_instrument_new,
        h.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
        sec.abor_issue_date as issue_date_abor,
        cast(h.abor_maturity_date as DATE) AS maturity_date_abor,
        cast('CPPIBSEC_ID' as VARCHAR) AS instrument_id_type,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        h.security_group_id AS instrument_sub_group_code,
         h.security_group_name AS instrument_sub_group_name,
         h.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
         h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
         h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
         h.balance_nominal_number AS current_nominal,
        h.balance_nominal_number*h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency + h.next_coupon_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency + h.next_coupon_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
         h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
         h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
         h.clean_price AS current_clean_price,
         h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
         h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency AS book_value,
         h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
         h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS current_accrued_amount,
         h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
         h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
         h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
         h.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency AS current_accrued_amount_pc,
         sec.abor_quote_factor AS quote_factor,

         sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_frequency_unit_source,
         sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_frequency_length_source,
         NULL AS next_coupon_date_source,
         '2025-06-02' as business_date,
         sec.abor_issue_currency AS quoted_currency_code
         from RankedSecurities sec
         left join reference.scd_party_issuer par
               on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id and sec.business_date = par.business_date
          join holdings.scd_holdings_main h
               on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id

         and h.security_group_id in ('MBS', 'SINKBOND', 'ABSFR')

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 04:48:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
